name: UIExecutionAgent
description: Runs generated TypeScript Playwright .spec.ts files (or legacy pytest .py files) via subprocess, streams progress, handles browser-close/headless-switch heuristics, and returns a flat per-test results list. Phase 0: base URL resolved explicitly or the run fails fast (blocking) — no localhost fallback; runs spanning modules with different URLs are split per module; MTA_ALLOWED_HOSTS is passed to the runtime host guard; a normalised execution_results v2 record is written to reports/mta/.

inputs.name: module_filter
inputs.description: Scope execution to one module's specs

inputs.name: safety
inputs.description: Resolved SafetyPolicy (allowed_hosts -> MTA_ALLOWED_HOSTS); derived from project.yaml when absent

outputs.name: report_json
outputs.description: Path to the Playwright JSON report

outputs.name: run_errors
outputs.description: Errors of failed sub-runs when a run was split per module
